context: M4 o5c. The Carriers' men are gone. Baek sits on a crate of wigs, his glasses cracked.

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: Thank you. Now two of us are bruised. Better than one.

lines.speaker: char.dwayne_little
lines.text: Used-to-be! You hit like a cop! I mean that nice!

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: They'll be back with friends, Mr. Baek.

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: Then I'll need more wigs to sit on.
